desc: Ranga Shankara is one of Bangalore's well known theatres. It is located in the south Bangalore area of J.P Nagar and is run by the Sanket Trust. The auditorium, which opened in 2004, was envisioned by Arundathi Nag, in remembrance of her late husband, Shankar Nag, who was a renowned actor in the Kannada film industry.

desc: Ravindra Natya Grah is a theatre auditorium and exhibition hall located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. The theater is named after Rabindranath Tagore who became the first non-European to win the Nobel Prize. It is run by Indore Municipal Corporation and has with the capacity of 799 persons with a parking facilities and also has Hotel Apsara in its campus.
